text: By the influence of the absence of false perception, the absence of negligence, and the absence of passion, and also by the influence of effort, the soul, which has penetrated the subtle single-field, performs the taking in and clinging to the infinite regions of matter (pudgala) that are fit for karmic bondage; this is bondage. It is stated: "Because of the presence of passion, the soul takes in matter that is fit for the arising of karma; this is bondage."
